description: One rubric with its criteria — each criterion's name, what the judge looks for, and the score scale. Read this to explain a score (which criterion slipped and what it asks for) or before caliper_rubrics_update. Get the rubricId from caliper_rubrics_list or an eval's rubricId.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.

name: caliper_rubrics_get
title: Read a Caliper rubric (criteria + scales)
